newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ c/a deficit seen peaking at NZ$4.86 bln in 98/9.
newsitem.headline: NZ c/a deficit seen peaking at NZ$4.86 bln in 98/9.

text.p: New Zealand's current account deficit would peak at NZ$4.859 billion, 4.6 percent of GDP, in the 1998/99 March year, Treasury forecast in its December Economic and Fiscal Update published on Monday.
In its last forecast in September, Treasury saw the deficit peaking at $5.1 billion, 5.0 percent of GDP, in the 1998/99 year.
In 1999/2000, the current account deficit would fall to $3.975 billion, or 3.6 percent of GDP, Treasury said.
